SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers RESTS, BAR LINES, DOUBLE BAR LINES & CLEFS, part of MUSIC BRAILLE NOTATION in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do you write rests, bar lines, double bar lines and clefs in music braille? 2. How do you differentiate rests from double bar lines and clefs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the rests, bar lines, double bar lines and clefs by naming the specific dots that form them for knowledge.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of RESTS, BAR LINES, DOUBLE BAR LINES & CLEFS in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
